note: `vconcat' over every combination the brief names: vector+vector, vector+list, a string alone, and no arguments at all. Emacs: ([1 2 3] [1 2 3] [97 98] []). The string row is the one worth reading twice -- a string concatenates as its CHARACTER CODES, so (vconcat "ab") is [97 98] and not ["ab"] or [?a ?b] printed as characters.
